description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 23W Calypso Crossing” at High Pointe Resort, located in Seacrest Beach. Wake up to stunning ocean views, stroll to your private beach, or unwind by the resort-style pool. Tucked between Rosemary and Alys Beach, this 2-suite condo puts you steps away from incredible dining, boutique shopping, and endless adventure. Whether you're here to relax or explore, this is the perfect home base for your 30A getaway. Ready for the ultimate escape? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-Front Condo with Stunning Views – Wake up to breathtaking ocean views and let the sound of the waves set the tone for your perfect getaway.Resort-Style Pool with Waterfalls and Hot Tub – Relax in a tropical paradise with a luxurious pool, soothing waterfalls, and a hot tub to melt your stress away.Exclusive Private Beach Access for Guests – Enjoy the serenity of a secluded beach experience, with pristine sands and crystal-clear waters reserved just for you.Walkable to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, Dining, and Shops – Immerse yourself in the charm of coastal living, exploring boutique shops, delicious dining, and picturesque surroundings—all just steps away. Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"The condo was spotless, incredibly spacious, and the Gulf views were absolutely stunning. The perfect location for a relaxing getaway!" – Julie⭐"The pool, private beach access, and a variety of nearby restaurants made this the ultimate spot for our family vacation. Truly unforgettable!" – Kristen⭐"Breathtaking Gulf views, effortless access to Rosemary Beach, and a gorgeous pool. This place has it all—we can’t wait to return!" – Alexandra*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a stunning open-concept living and dining area, adorned with elegant coastal decor and offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Gulf. Whether you’re looking to unwind or entertain, this space is designed to impress and inspire.Luxurious, plush seating positioned by Gulf-facing windows for breathtaking views,/li>Oversized flat-screen TV, perfect for cozy movie nightsExpansive private balcony featuring comfortable sun loungers and a stylish dining table for 4, offering the perfect setting to relax and soak in breathtaking sunsets.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The state-of-the-art kitchen is thoughtfully designed for creating everything from quick, effortless snacks to indulgent, restaurant-quality gourmet meals—all while soaking in the stunning, panoramic Gulf views.Sleek stainless steel appliances paired with generous counter space for all your cooking needsStylish breakfast bar featuring comfortable stool seating for 4, perfect for casual meals or entertainingSpacious dining area with a beautifully set table for 4, ideal for family gatherings or dinner parties*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***The bedrooms and bathrooms are designed for comfort and relaxation. Bedrooms feature cozy bedding, chic décor, and large windows for natural light. Ensuite bathrooms include modern fixtures and spa-like details, perfect for unwinding.Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities, oversized soaking tub and walk-in shower.Queen Guest Suite: 2 Queen Beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, walk-in shower and secondary hall access.*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***High Pointe Resort offers luxurious, premium amenities crafted for the ultimate relaxation, unforgettable fun, and a truly exceptional getaway experience.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a resort-like Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Perfectly situated between the charm of Rosemary Beach and the elegance of Alys Beach, Calypso Crossing provides unparalleled access to 30A’s most sought-after attractions.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.This property has 1 included beach set-up available 3/6 to 10/31, featuring 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 204348
